_about: Google Flow, as Open TAN drives it (law 34). Prices read live from the create panel 2026-11-15 (tools/flow/panel.mjs + the Omni 1.2 Length slider walk; same prices in Frames and Ingredients, 16:9 and 9:16, x2 = 2 × x1). Model facts from Google's own Flow help center and model pages (sources below). Goal (owner 2026-11-15): the most video for the fewest credits — a clip ≤ 10 credits, at most 15 for 10 s.

panel.input: Frames = start (and end) image, the prompt describes the move between them · Ingredients = reference images / characters / @Voice, named in the prompt
panel.length: Omni 1.1 Flash: buttons 4/6/8/10 s · Omni 1.2 Flash: Length slider 3–15 s · Veo 3.1 Lite: no switch (8 s)
panel.outputs: x1–x4, each output full price — always x1
panel.price: footer 'Generating will use N credits' — read before every generation (tools/flow/set.mjs --expect)

account.plan: PRO (1,000 credits a month, reset each billing cycle, no roll-over) + 50 free credits a day (do not carry over)
account.charged: when a generation starts; failed or safety-blocked generations are refunded within ~1 h
account.visible_watermark: required in India (the Veo wordmark; law 28 removes it from our clips); SynthID always stays
account.images: Flow image generation costs NO credits: daily limits on PRO — Nano Banana Pro 100 / day, Nano Banana 2.1 + 2 Lite 1,000 / day shared, 2K upscale 200 / day

price.360p: 1 credit / s up to 10 s, 2 / s for seconds 11–15
price.720p: 3 credits / s up to 10 s, 6 / s for seconds 11–15

models.extras: Extend (+3–10 s a turn, same per-second price, paid plans) · edit / refine an existing clip · upscale to 1080p free (≤ 10 s), 4K Ultra only · @Voice references (Ingredients) · up to 6 reference images
models.best: consistency of faces, clothes, packaging text and brand colours; little morphing; better lip sync and several speakers; FPV, orbit, zoom-out camera moves
models.weak: very fast sports, complex physics, quick script changes; cuts between shots by default — write 'single continuous shot, no scene cuts'

models.extras: Frames (first, or first + last) · Ingredients (8 s) · no Extend (Veo Extend retired 2026-11-05)
models.best: cheapest real-looking 720p with sound (1.25 credits / s); beats Veo 3.1 Fast in Google's own comparison; cinematic camera language
models.weak: fixed 8 s; short spoken lines can be unreliable

models.status: retiring 2026-12-05 — use until then for exact short 720p lengths
retiring 2026-12-05 — not used (Lite is better and half the price)

image_models.best: fast, high quality, better text, consistent characters — start frames and ingredients

prompting.veo: Cinematography + Subject + Action + Context + Style & ambiance; dialogue in quotes (A woman says, "…"); SFX: … ; Ambient noise: …
prompting.omni: shot · subject · environment · motion · a sound line; 'single continuous shot, no scene cuts' or timecodes [0-5s] one action each; name the references ('Using the provided images for …'); exact on-screen words in quotes; 'No dialogue' / 'No extra sound effects' when unwanted; no negative-prompt field — write exclusions in the prompt
prompting.camera: dolly, tracking, crane, aerial, slow pan, POV, wide, close-up, low angle, shallow depth of field, macro, wide-angle

upscale.free: Flow's own upscale is 0 credits for clips ≤ 10 s (balance unchanged in both tests)
upscale.quality: Flow 720p upscale of an Omni 1.2 360p clip: label text and droplets crisp, ~6.5× the detail of a classic Lanczos upscale (TAN Upscaler)
upscale.how: tools/flow/upscale.mjs: clip's More options → Download → '<tier> Upscaled', Chrome's download routed straight into the job folder

routes.720p: Omni 1.2 Flash at 360p (1 credit / s) → Flow 720p — 10 s for 10 credits
routes.1080p: a native 720p clip (Veo 3.1 Lite 8 s = 10) → Flow 1080p

upscale.limit: an upscaled download is not a Flow clip, so 360p → 720p → 1080p is not possible; 1080p needs a native 720p clip
